newsitem.title: USA: Ariz. Palo Verde nuclear unit refuel on schedule.
newsitem.headline: Ariz. Palo Verde nuclear unit refuel on schedule.

text.p: Unit 1 at the Palo Verde nuclear plant is on track or slightly ahead of its refueling schedule, plant operator Arizona Public Service Co, which is owned by Pinnacle West Capital Corp, said Tuesday.
The 1,221-megawatt unit (MW) was shut Sept 21 for a 44-day refueling outage but that may be shortened by two or three days, said spokesman Craig Nesbit.
Palo Verde's other two 1,221-MW units are operating at 100 percent, he noted.

Pinnacle West has a 29.1 percent interest in the nuclear plant. Other owners include: El Paso Electric, with a 15.8 percent stake, Enova Corp (15.8 percent) and Public Service Co of New Mexico (10.2 percent), with other local utilities owning the remainder.
